svg.aria-label: Every design placed in space and time. Each panel is one design, in four columns by who decides: owner-decider, separate-decider, single-decider, and no-decider. Its rows are places: in a node, above SQL, below SQL, below the access methods, below the buffer pool. Its columns are four steps in sequence. S is the split point, V the validation point, R the replication point, and a green band marks when the transaction executes, which has no fixed place. Owner-deciders split first, then validate and replicate. Separate-deciders decide first: Calvin orders, marked O, before it executes, then validates as it runs; DSQL validates after it executes, and Oracle RAC while it runs. Single-deciders validate in the one writer while it executes. No-deciders never validate: Cassandra and Riak split and replicate below their query language, and cr-sqlite replicates with no split. Below the key-value store, the no-decider column is empty.
